paper_id: Zhu et al. - 2013 - Understanding Routing Dynamics in a Large-Scale Wireless Sensor Network
title: Understanding Routing Dynamics in a Large-scale Wireless Sensor Network
motivation: Large-scale WSN部署中,环境动态影响链路质量,但路由动态的根因和影响尚不清楚
problem_framing: 通过分析parent change事件的时间空间分布,关联loop和drop事件来定位根因
key_insight: Parent change主要影响局部节点,环境湿度和路由环路是主因,约30%换父不必要
method_signature: 从有限日志中提取parent change/loop/no-ack事件,按时间空间相关性分组识别TPC/IPC事件
evaluation_criteria: PDR改善率,换父有效性系数,皮尔逊相关系数,事件频率和持续时间CDF
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 日志缺失导致无法精确判断parent change时机,只能近似估计路由链路寿命
evidence_for_taste: we cannot simply conclude that the large number of parent changes is caused by the interference or heavy traffic
30% of nodes suffers from ineffective routing decisions
ineffective routing oscillation will be incurred
Parent change events mostly impact only local nodes
we are unable to obtain the ground truth
it is difficult to measure the accurate lifetime of the routing links
thinking_moves: 从系统日志中只能获得累计计数器,无法直接观测事件,需设计启发式规则推断事件发生时间
将parent change事件分为触发型(TPC)和受影响型(IPC)两类,缩小根因搜索范围
用auto-correlation发现FPC事件的24小时周期性,关联湿度数据推断环境因素
通过RSSI阈值判断旧链路是否真的变差,近似评估换父是否有效
放弃精确建模,转而用空间时间相关性聚类事件来找规律
